arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-scoped helper: construct and validate the requested team meeting calendar event.

Semantics derived from the trusted task: one event, next Wednesday at 15:00,
lasting exactly one hour. Timezone defaults to UTC (explicit per calendar best
practices); the user may request a different timezone afterward.
"""
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
import uuid

WEDNESDAY = 2  # datetime.weekday(): Monday=0 ... Sunday=6


def next_wednesday(from_date):
    """Return the next Wednesday strictly after from_date."""
    days_ahead = (WEDNESDAY - from_date.weekday()) % 7
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return from_date + timedelta(days=days_ahead)


today = datetime.now(timezone.utc).date()
wed = next_wednesday(today)

dtstart = datetime(wed.year, wed.month, wed.day, 15, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
dtend = dtstart + timedelta(hours=1)
dtstamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
uid = f"team-meeting-{uuid.uuid4()}@workspace"

ics_lines = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Workspace//Calendar Skill//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "METHOD:PUBLISH",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    f"UID:{uid}",
    f"DTSTAMP:{dtstamp.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}",
    f"DTSTART:{dtstart.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}",
    f"DTEND:{dtend.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}",
    "SUMMARY:Team Meeting",
    "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
    "BEGIN:VALARM",
    "ACTION:DISPLAY",
    "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting starts in 15 minutes",
    "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
    "END:VALARM",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
]
ics = "\r\n".join(ics_lines) + "\r\n"

# --- Validation ---
required = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR", "END:VCALENDAR",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT", "END:VEVENT",
    "UID:", "DTSTAMP:", "DTSTART:", "DTEND:", "SUMMARY:",
]
for token in required:
    assert token in ics, f"missing required field {token!r}"
assert (dtend - dtstart) == timedelta(hours=1), "event must last exactly one hour"
assert dtend > dtstart, "DTEND must be after DTSTART"
# No line exceeds RFC 5545's 75-octet folding limit
for line in ics_lines:
    assert len(line.encode("utf-8")) <= 75, f"line too long: {line!r}"

print(f"Computed next Wednesday: {wed.isoformat()}")
print(f"Start (UTC): {dtstart.isoformat()}")
print(f"End   (UTC): {dtend.isoformat()}")
print(f"Duration : {dtend - dtstart}")
print("---ICS---")
print(ics, end="")
print("---VALIDATION OK---")
